TSL has no operators: every shader file does its arithmetic with .add and .mul. Shared shader steps already live in one place each (sunlit, throughAir, the hull and sky pieces); this pair is the language, not a copied procedure. (It surfaced when render/liftStair.ts became render/tiled.ts, which moved the finder's corpus-wide counts.)
